'''Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Ltd.''' ('''BHSL''') is a [[sugar]] producer in India. It has an aggregated sugarcane crushing capacity of 136,000 tonnes crushed per day (TCD), and alcohol distillation capacity of 800 kilo liters per day (KLD) across 14 locations in the north Indian state of [[Uttar Pradesh]]. The company also produces green fuel ethanol.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-company/earnings/Bajaj-Hindusthan-back-in-black-posts-Rs-69cr-profit-in-Sep-Qtr/articleshow/5343661.cms|title=Bajaj Hindusthan back in black; posts Rs 69cr profit in Sep Qtr |date=16 December 2009|work=The Economic Times|accessdate=28 February 2010|location=India}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/articleshow/3885714.cms|title=Bajaj Hindusthan gains four per cent on BSE |date=24 December 2008<!--, 1331 hrs IST, PTI-->|work=The Economic Times|accessdate=28 February 2010|location=India}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://in.reuters.com/article/domesticNews/idINBOM11146820080609 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100303171624/http://in.reuters.com/article/domesticNews/idINBOM11146820080609 |url-status=dead |archive-date=3 March 2010 |title=REFILE-Farmers lay siege to Bajaj Hindusthan mill – paper|work=Reuters |date=9 June 2008 |accessdate=2010-02-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2007/10/22/stories/2007102252040100.htm |title=Bajaj Hindusthan to pay only Rs 60/quintal for cane |work=Business Line |date=22 October 2007 |accessdate=2010-02-28| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20100405064159/http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2007/10/22/stories/2007102252040100.htm| archivedate= 5 April 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Udayan Mukherjee |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/udayans-comments/balrampur-chini-to-surge-if-bajaj-hindusthan-buys-its-stake_421794.html |title=Balrampur Chini to surge if Bajaj Hindusthan buys its stake – CNBC-TV18 |publisher=Moneycontrol.com |accessdate=2010-02-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.livemint.com/2009/10/30224120/Bajaj-Hindusthan-eyes-Balrampu.html|title=Bajaj Hindusthan eyes Balrampur mills; No. 2 global spot within reach – Corporate News |publisher=livemint.com |date=30 October 2009 |accessdate=2010-02-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.hindu.com/thehindu/holnus/006200704241510.htm |title=Bajaj Hindusthan Q2 net drops 94% to Rs 3.66 crore |agency=Press Trust of India |work=The Hindu |date=24 April 2007 |accessdate=2010-02-28| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20100406040156/http://www.hindu.com/thehindu/holnus/006200704241510.htm| archivedate= 6 April 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref> It is a member of [[Bajaj Group]]. The company is headquartered in [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://business.mapsofindia.com/india-company/b/bajaj-hindustan.html |title=Bajaj Hindusthan |publisher=Business.mapsofindia.com |accessdate=2011-01-28}}</ref>

The site selected for the first plant was at [[Gola Gokarannath]] in district [[Lakhimpur Kheri]] in the Terai region of Uttar Pradesh (UP), an area rich in sugar cane. Another sugar plant with a cane crushing capacity of 1400 TCD was set up in 1972 at [[Palia Kalan]], a large cane supplying centre about 70 kilometres from [[Gola Gokarannath]].<ref name="Company History">{{Cite web |title=Bajaj Hindustan Sugar Mills - Company History |url=http://www.bajajhindusthan.com/company-history.php}}</ref>

Kushagra Bajaj is the Chairman of Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Ltd.<ref name="www.bseindia.com">[http://www.bseindia.com/corporates/anndet_new.aspx?newsid=e0d9683e-6417-4413-b806-c842826cc279 BSE India.] Chairman of Bajaj Hindusthan</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bajajhindusthan.com/board-of-directors.php |title=Mr. Kushagra Bajaj is the Chairman of Bajaj Hindusthan|publisher=bajajhindusthan.com}}</ref>

== History ==
The company was founded as Hindusthan Sugar Mills Limited by [[Jamnalal Bajaj]] in 1931. In 1988, it was renamed Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited.<ref>{{cite news |title=70 companies with pre-1947 roots |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/IvqNiC0KHlZg9ZOXhFbe4O/70-companies-with-pre1947-roots.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=24 August 2017}}</ref>

Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Ltd. (BHSL) is a sugar producer in India. It has an aggregated sugarcane crushing capacity of 136,000 tonnes crushed per day (TCD), and alcohol distillation capacity of 800 kilo liters per day (KLD) across 14 locations in the north Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. The company also produces green fuel ethanol. It is a member of Bajaj Group. The company is headquartered in Mumbai.
The site selected for the first plant was at Gola Gokarannath in district Lakhimpur Kheri in the Terai region of Uttar Pradesh (UP), an area rich in sugar cane. Another sugar plant with a cane crushing capacity of 1400 TCD was set up in 1972 at Palia Kalan, a large cane supplying centre about 70 kilometres from Gola Gokarannath.
Kushagra Bajaj is the Chairman of Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Ltd.
